title: Claims Manual, Labor-Only Tiers: Labor Allowed on Calls Billed at an After-Hours Labor Multiplier
content:
### Rule

On a claim filed against a Harbison 5-Year Labor Protection or Harbison 10-Year Labor Protection contract of Harbison Protection Contracts, the labor allowed depends on the call class of the claim's service call and on the symptom the call was booked for. Both are read from the service call record under Repair and Emergency Service Calls: the call class carries a labor multiplier, and the call shows the symptom it was booked for.

- **Urgent booking at a multiplier above one.** Where the claim's service call was booked for no heat, no cooling or a carbon monoxide alarm and its call class carries a labor multiplier above one, the labor allowed is the labor net up to the component sublimit multiplied by that labor multiplier.
- **Other booking at a multiplier above one.** Where the call class carries a labor multiplier above one and the call was booked for any other symptom, the labor allowed is the labor net divided by that labor multiplier, up to the component sublimit.
- **Multiplier of one.** On a call class whose labor multiplier is one, the labor allowed is the labor net up to the component sublimit.

Here the labor net is the repair labor line of the failed component's price-book task on the claim's service call, less the Comfort Club member repair discount posted against it, and the component sublimit is the tier's labor sublimit for the failed component's group.

### Decision table

| Call class labor multiplier | Booked symptom | Labor allowed |
|---|---|---|
| above one | no heat, no cooling or carbon monoxide alarm | the lesser of the labor net and the component sublimit multiplied by the multiplier |
| above one | any other symptom | the lesser of the labor net divided by the multiplier and the component sublimit |
| one | any symptom | the lesser of the labor net and the component sublimit |

Where the failed component has no labor sublimit, nothing caps the figure: the labor allowed is the labor net in the first and third rows, and the labor net divided by the multiplier in the second.

### Worked cases (hypothetical; the multiplier and sublimit are illustrative figures)

Compressor claim, labor net $1500.00, illustrative compressor sublimit $1200.00, illustrative multiplier 1.5:

- booked for no cooling: the sublimit multiplied by 1.5 is $1800.00; the lesser of $1500.00 and $1800.00 is **$1500.00**;
- booked for a noisy outdoor unit: $1500.00 divided by 1.5 is $1000.00; the lesser of $1000.00 and $1200.00 is **$1000.00**;
- same claim on a call class with a multiplier of one: the lesser of $1500.00 and $1200.00 is **$1200.00**.
